deed: חוקרי הטכניון מפתחים עם טבע את רזאג׳ילין לטיפול בחולי פרקינסון
title: Technion researchers Youdim and Finberg developed Azilect, a drug for Parkinson's patients, with Teva

trailer.text: Prof. Moussa Youdim and Prof. John Finberg, researchers at the Faculty of Medicine at the Technion in Haifa, developed the Parkinson's drug rasagiline together with Teva Israel.
Calcalist describes both of them as Zionist Jews who were born and lived abroad and immigrated to Israel.
According to Finberg, the drug, called Azilect, inhibits the breakdown of dopamine in the brain.
According to Teva, Azilect was approved in Europe and Israel in 2005, and according to the FDA record it was approved in the US on May 16, 2006.
In 2016 the Technion held a tribute to the two developers, and in 2022 Youdim received the Israel Prize in life sciences, Globes reports.

glance.label: Developers
glance.value: Prof. Moussa Youdim and Prof. John Finberg, the Technion, with Teva

glance.label: Start of research
glance.value: According to what Youdim told Calcalist, in 1978, while he was in England, a student of his conducted research on the molecule, and Finberg joined a year later.

glance.label: Recognition

stations.title: A disease with no drug that stops it

paragraphs.text: Parkinson's usually affects older people.
According to Teva, in 2006 there were about 4 million patients worldwide, about one million of them in the US.
According to an article by Finberg, all available treatments for Parkinson's treat symptoms only, despite a large effort to find drugs that would slow the loss of nerve cells.
According to Finberg, L-dopa is the most effective drug for the symptoms, but it has serious motor and psychiatric side effects.
The patient Paul Knopf said in 2006 that he sometimes forgets to take his medications and runs out of them, so he carries pills with him.

stations.title: Two researchers who immigrated to Israel

paragraphs.text: According to Globes, Moussa Youdim was born in Iran, was sent at age 12 to a boarding school in England, and studied medicine, biochemistry and psychiatry.
Calcalist describes him as a Jew of Iranian origin who was sent alone to England to study.
According to Israel21c, he was educated in Great Britain and Canada, and became interested in pharmacology and neurochemistry for a very personal reason.
According to Israel21c, Youdim was invited to leave England and found the pharmacology department at the Technion.
According to Globes, he immigrated to Israel in 1977 and settled in Haifa.
According to Calcalist, John Finberg was born in England and immigrated to Israel after the Six-Day War.
According to Calcalist, Finberg lost his father to Parkinson's disease.
Finberg said he began working on the drug by chance, with no connection to his father's illness.
According to Israel21c, Youdim came across a drug against depression that was effective, but a side effect of it made it almost unmarketable.
Youdim told Calcalist that the research on the molecule began in 1978 in England, and that Finberg joined a year later.

According to Israel21c, his work on another compound from the same family, which he had discovered in Australia and begun developing into what would become rasagiline, was interrupted when he was invited to leave England and found the pharmacology department at the Technion.
According to the Technion, in the 1970s Youdim and Finberg developed rasagiline, and it was found to be effective in preventing the death of nerve cells in the brain.
Youdim said he planned to make the drug commercial in order to buy himself standing in the new country.
According to Israel21c, the drug was designed to help block the breakdown of dopamine, a substance that cells use for signaling and that controls muscle movement.
According to the article, at therapeutic doses it hardly inhibits the enzyme MAO-A and does not cause the so-called cheese effect.
According to Finberg, it lacks the amphetamine-like activity of the drug that preceded it, selegiline.
Youdim approached Teva with the idea of developing the compound into a treatment for Parkinson's, and the first time the company was not interested.
In Globes he said that in the 1980s he approached Teva twice without any interest.
According to Israel21c, later Teva was larger and more stable, became interested in developing new drugs, and the collaboration with the Technion began.
According to Youdim, Dr. Ruth Levy, then Teva's chief scientist, was enthusiastic about the drug and decided to push its development.
Youdim said the development would not have been possible without Teva CEO Eli Hurvitz, who decided that Teva would develop an original drug in Israel and not only generic drugs.

stations.title: The approval: one pill a day

paragraphs.text: According to Teva's announcement, Teva developed Azilect based on research originating from the Technion.
According to the company, the approval was based on three large, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical studies at many medical centers.
According to Teva, over 1,600 patients took part in the studies, and they showed that the drug in a daily dose is effective and well tolerated.
According to Teva, Azilect was approved in Europe and Israel in 2005 and was marketed there successfully.
According to the company, in 2006 it was marketed in 13 European Union countries in collaboration with Lundbeck.
According to the FDA record, the drug was approved in the US on May 16, 2006.
According to Globes, it was approved both as monotherapy in the early stage of the disease and as an addition to levodopa in moderate to advanced stages.
Teva CEO Israel Makov said that Azilect fills an unmet need, because it combines efficacy, convenient once-daily dosing and good tolerability.
Prof. Warren Olanow of Mount Sinai said patients can look forward to a new effective treatment that improves symptoms and is taken once a day.
According to Globes, Azilect is the Teva original drug that came after Copaxone for multiple sclerosis.
In May 2006 Teva announced that it had begun a large clinical study called ADAGIO, examining whether Azilect slows the progression of Parkinson's.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the study treated patients in an early stage at 129 medical centers in 14 countries over 18 months.
According to the newspaper, groups that received Azilect were compared with control groups.
According to Finberg, patients who received 1 mg a day for 18 months were in a significantly better clinical state than those who received the drug for only 9 months.
According to Finberg, at a dose of 2 mg the effect was not significant.
According to the Jerusalem Post in 2008, the results showed a slowing of the disease's progression, a first of its kind.
According to Calcalist, Teva announced in June 2008 that Azilect can slow the spread of the disease.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Teva intended to submit the results to the authorities in the US and Europe.
Youdim said the results slow the spread of the disease only in those who are already ill.
According to him, there is no way to detect the disease early, and by diagnosis more than half of the important nerve cells have already been lost.
Finberg said the latest trial was not carried out by them, and so they have no hand in the results themselves.

stations.title: Recognition, pride and what came after

paragraphs.text: According to Calcalist, the drug's success placed the Technion on the small list of institutions in the world that have developed an original drug.
Youdim told Israel21c that the team competed with major drug companies from a small laboratory in Israel and beat them.
He told Calcalist that eight large companies tried to develop a drug for Parkinson's and all of them failed.
He called Azilect "a blue-and-white drug that everyone can be proud of".
The chairman of the Israel Parkinson Association, Daniel Neumann, said in 2008 that as Israelis they are proud that the hope for the world's Parkinson's patients comes from Israel.
Calcalist wrote that the achievement might win the two researchers a Nobel Prize, and they declined to comment on this.
In 2016 the Technion, at an event of the Board of Governors, held a tribute to Youdim and Finberg.
Teva CEO Erez Vigodman wrote that the researchers had alleviated the suffering of many patients and given good days to thousands of people.
Technion President Prof. Peretz Lavie said that Azilect has a place of honor in the Technion Hall of Fame.
According to Globes, in 2022 Youdim received the Israel Prize in life sciences.
Youdim said that a center of excellence for neurodegenerative brain diseases was established, and that a Parkinson's association in the US awarded a grant.

stations.title: Money, difficulties and what did not succeed

paragraphs.text: Youdim told Globes that after his immigration he was promised budgets that did not arrive, and that his wife had many difficulties in the conversion process.
Neumann said in 2008 that the previous year the association had failed to persuade the Health Ministry's drug basket committee to include Azilect.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the rights to the drug are held by Teva.
Calcalist reported that the Technion's royalties would be lower than for Copaxone, because Azilect was transferred to Teva at an early stage.
Calcalist predicted in 2008 that Teva would have sales on the order of a billion dollars and that the researchers would not become millionaires.
According to Globes in 2026, rasagiline brought Teva at least 2.5 billion dollars, and Youdim and the Technion received royalties on it.
Globes wrote that in a dispute between Youdim and the Tax Authority it emerged that he himself had earned at least 10 million dollars from the drug.
An article on the drug states that Finberg is a co-discoverer of it and benefits financially from its sales.

Youdim said in 2008 that the development of an Alzheimer's drug called Ladostigil began with Teva, but Teva gave it up and he is continuing alone. According to Globes in 2026, the drug was later commercialized to the company Avraham Pharma and did not succeed there.
He said in 2026 that his team had published 900 articles with 80 thousand citations, but the Technion decided that a scientist has to retire.

claims.text: מנכ"ל טבע ישראל מקוב אמר ב-2006 שאזילקט ממלאת צורך שלא נענה, כי היא משלבת יעילות, מינון נוח פעם ביום וסבילות טובה.
claims.quote: AZILECT® fills an important unmet need, offering a new treatment which uniquely combines efficacy, convenient once-daily dosing and good tolerability.

claims.text: פרופ' וורן אולנוב ממאונט סיני אמר ב-2006 שהמטופלים יכולים לצפות לטיפול יעיל חדש שמשפר תסמינים ומציע מינון פשוט פעם ביום.
claims.quote: Patients can now look forward to an effective new treatment option that improves symptoms and offers the simplicity of once-daily dosing.

claims.text: לפי גלובס ב-2006, אזילקט היא תרופת המקור השנייה של טבע, אחרי קופקסון לטיפול בטרשת נפוצה.
claims.quote: Azilect is Teva's second ethical drug. The first was Copaxone, which has become a leading treatment for multiple sclerosis.

claims.text: במאי 2006 הודיעה טבע שהחלה במחקר קליני גדול (ADAGIO) לבדיקת השפעת אזילקט על האטת התקדמות הפרקינסון.
claims.quote: We have recently embarked on a large clinical study (ADAGIO), to investigate the impact of AZILECT® on slowing the progression of Parkinson's disease.

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט, מחקר ADAGIO טיפל ב-1,176 חולים בשלב מוקדם ב-129 מרכזים רפואיים ב-14 מדינות במשך 18 חודשים.
claims.quote: The ADAGIO study, which treated 1,176 patients with early Parkinson's at 129 medical centers in 14 countries over a period of 18 months

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט, קבוצות הטיפול קיבלו אזילקט והתקדמותן הושוותה לקבוצות ביקורת.
claims.quote: The treatment groups received Azilect, and their progress was compared with control groups.

claims.text: לפי פינברג, במחקר ADAGIO חולים שקיבלו 1 מ"ג ליום במשך 18 חודשים היו במצב קליני טוב יותר משמעותית מאלה שקיבלו 9 חודשים בלבד.
claims.quote: patients who received the drug at 1 mg daily for 18 months finished the trial period in a significantly better clinical status than those who received it for only 9 months

claims.text: לפי פינברג, ב-ADAGIO ההשפעה לא הייתה מובהקת במינון של 2 מ"ג.
claims.quote: although this effect was not significant at a dose of 2 mg

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט ב-2008, אזילקט פותחה על ידי פרופ' יודעים ופינברג מהטכניון, ותוצאות ADAGIO הראו האטה של התקדמות הפרקינסון, דבר ראשון מסוגו.
claims.quote: to be effective at slowing the progression of the chronic and fatal neurological disease, a first for any drug

claims.text: לפי כלכליסט ב-17.6.2008, טבע הודיעה אתמול שאזילקט מסוגלת להאט את התפשטות המחלה.
claims.quote: אתמול הודיעה חברת טבע כי התרופה מסוג אזילקט מסוגלת להאט את התפשטות המחלה

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט, טבע התכוונה להגיש את תוצאות המחקר לרשויות הרגולציה בארה"ב ובאירופה.
claims.quote: Teva intends to submit these results to the regulatory authorities in the US and Europe.

claims.text: יודעים אמר ב-2008 שתוצאות הניסוי רק מעכבות את התפשטות המחלה אצל מי שכבר חלה.
claims.quote: הן רק מעכבות את התפשטות המחלה אצל מי שכבר חלה

claims.text: יודעים אמר ב-2008 שאין זיהוי מוקדם של המחלה, ושעם האבחנה כבר אבדו יותר ממחצית הנוירונים החשובים.
claims.quote: ברגע שחולה מזוהה כמי שלקה בפרקינסון, זה כבר מאוחר מדי, היות שהוא כבר הספיק לאבד יותר ממחצית הניורונים החשובים במוח

claims.text: פינברג אמר ב-2008 שהניסוי הקליני האחרון לא בוצע על ידם ולכן אין להם יד בתוצאות עצמן.
claims.quote: הניסוי הקליני האחרון לא בוצע כלל על ידינו, לכן אין לנו יד ורגל בתוצאות עצמן

claims.text: לפי כלכליסט, הצלחת התרופה הכניסה את הטכניון לרשימה המצומצמת של מוסדות בעולם שפיתחו תרופת מקור.
claims.quote: הצלחתה של התרופה הכניסה את הטכניון לרשימה המצומצמת של מוסדות בעולם שהצליחו לפתח תרופת מקור

claims.text: יודעים אמר ל-Israel21c שהצוות התחרה בחברות תרופות גדולות מתוך מעבדה קטנה בישראל וניצח אותן.
claims.quote: we have competed with major drug companies, and have beaten them at their own game

claims.text: יודעים אמר לכלכליסט ב-2008 ששמונה חברות גדולות ניסו לפתח תרופה לפרקינסון וכולן נכשלו.
claims.quote: לא פחות משמונה חברות גדולות ניסו לפתח תרופה לפרקינסון וכולן נכשלו

claims.text: יודעים אמר לכלכליסט שמדובר בתרופה כחול לבן שכולם יכולים להתגאות בה.
claims.quote: מדובר בתרופה כחול לבן, שכולם יכולים להתגאות בה

claims.text: יו"ר האגודה הישראלית לפרקינסון דניאל נוימן אמר ב-2008 שכישראלים הם גאים שהתקווה לחולי פרקינסון בעולם יוצאת מישראל.
claims.quote: as Israelis, we are proud that the hope for all the world's Parkinson patients emanates from Israel

claims.text: כלכליסט כתב ב-2008 שההישג המדעי עשוי לזכות את שני החוקרים בפרס נובל, והם מסרבים להתייחס לכך.
claims.quote: כאמור, ההישג המדעי של שני החוקרים בתחום הפרקינסון עשוי לזכותם בפרס נובל ברפואה

claims.text: מנכ"ל טבע ארז ויגודמן כתב ב-2016 שהחוקרים הקלו על סבלם של חולים רבים וסיפקו ימים טובים לאלפי אנשים.
claims.quote: you should be proud of your work, which has alleviated the suffering of many patients and that has provided good days for thousands of people living in the shadow of this disease.

claims.text: נשיא הטכניון פרופ' פרץ לביא אמר ב-2016 שלאזילקט יש מקום של כבוד בהיכל התהילה של הטכניון.
claims.quote: Azilect has pride of place in the the Technion Hall of Fame.

claims.text: יודעים סיפר שהוקם מרכז מצוינות למחלות ניווניות של המוח, ושעמותה לפרקינסון בארה"ב העניקה מענק.
claims.quote: הקמנו מרכז מצוינות למחלות ניווניות של המוח, והעמותה לפרקינסון

claims.text: יודעים סיפר לגלובס שאחרי העלייה הבטיחו לו תקציבים ולא קיבל אותם, ולאשתו נערמו קשיים בהליך הגיור.
claims.quote: לא נתנו לי את התקציבים שהובטחו לי, אבל גרוע מכך, לאשתי עשו בעיות עם הגיור

claims.text: נוימן אמר ב-2008 שבשנה הקודמת האגודה ניסתה ולא הצליחה לשכנע את ועדת סל התרופות של משרד הבריאות לכלול את אזילקט.
claims.quote: Last year, we tried but failed to persuade the Health Ministry's public committee that recommends new drugs for inclusion in the basket of health services

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט ב-2008, טבע הישראלית מחזיקה בזכויות על אזילקט.
claims.quote: Israel's Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. has the rights to Azilect

claims.text: כלכליסט דיווח ב-2008 שהתמלוגים שיקבל הטכניון יהיו נמוכים יותר מאשר בקופקסון, כי אזילקט הועברה לטבע בשלב מוקדם.
claims.quote: ולכן התמלוגים להם יזכה הטכניון יהיו נמוכים יותר

claims.text: כלכליסט צפה ב-2008 שטבע תיהנה ממכירות של מיליארד דולר ושהחוקרים לא יהפכו למיליונרים.
claims.quote: אף שהם בעצמם לא יהפכו למיליונרים, טבע תיהנה ממכירות של מיליארד דולר

claims.text: לפי גלובס ב-2026, הרסגילין הניבה לטבע לפחות 2.5 מיליארד דולר, ויודעים והטכניון קיבלו עליה תמלוגים.
claims.quote: היא הניבה לחברה 2.5 מיליארד דולר לפחות, ויודעים והטכניון קיבלו עליה תמלוגים

claims.text: גלובס כתב שבמחלוקת בין יודעים לרשות המסים נחשף שהוא עצמו הרוויח מהתרופה לפחות 10 מיליון דולר.
claims.quote: במסגרת מחלוקת בין יודעים לרשות המסים, נחשף בעבר שהוא עצמו הרוויח ממנה לפחות 10 מיליון דולר

claims.text: במאמר מצוין שג'ון פינברג הוא מגלה שותף של רסגילין ומרוויח כספית ממכירות התרופה.

claims.quote: פרסמנו 900 מאמרים עם 80 אלף ציטוטים וזכינו בפרסים, אבל הם החליטו שמדען צריך לפרוש

claims.quote: AZILECT® is the second product to come out of Teva's substantial pipeline of innovative products

claims.text: לפי Israel21c ביוני 2006, אזילקט היא התרופה השלישית שפיתחה טבע.
claims.quote: Azilect is the third drug to be developed by Teva, today a multi-million dollar manufacturer of generic pharmaceuticals.
